 Tennis Picks
 Marie Bouzkova enters the second round of the 2026 Ningbo Open as a strong candidate to win outright and cover a sizable handicap (-5.5 games) against Anastasia Zakharova.
 Current Form:
 Marie Bouzkova posted a 6-4, 6-4 win over qualifier Kamila Rakhimova to clinch her spot in the second round of the 2026 Ningbo Open. Bouzkova is 3-2 in this year’s Asian swing of the WTA Tour.
 Anastasia Zakharova received a lucky loser entry into the main draw after Iga Swiatek withdrew from Ningbo Open due to injury. Zakharova lost to Polina Kudermetova 3-6, 3-6 in the final qualifying match of this tournament.
 The Matchup: This marks the first meeting between Zakharova and Bouzkova on the WTA Tour.

 Our Marie Bouzkova vs Anastasia Zakharova Prediction
